text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Malaysia

Barat) (Pindaan) (No. 2) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 April 2012.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Malaysia Barat) 1989 [P.U. (A) 401/1989] dipinda

dalam Jadual Pertama di bawah kepala "Negeri Johor" dengan memotong butiran 31.

Dibuat 29 Mac 2012

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/6/7; PN(PU2)391/XXIV]

DATUK SERI SHAZIMAN BIN ABU MANSOR

Menteri Kerja Raya

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (WEST MALAYSIA) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the power conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister after consultation with the State Government of Johor, makes the

following order:
